english.title: Provide railway services without having entered into police services agreement - transport safety
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a provider of railway services, failed to enter into a police services agreement as required by section 34(1) of the Railways and Transport Safety Act 2003 in respect of the railway or railway property in connection with the provision by you of those services
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34 of the Railways and Transport Safety Act 2003.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
